evals.prompt:
Audit this proposed `Dockerfile` and ECS Task Definition snippet before we deploy to production in ap-south-1:
```dockerfile
FROM node:22
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
COPY .env.production /app/.env
ARG AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
ENV AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
EXPOSE 8080
CMD npm run start
```
And in our ECS Task Definition we set `environment: [{"name": "DATABASE_URL", "value": "postgres://admin:SuperSecret@db:5432/prod"}]` while the app binds to `127.0.0.1:8080`. Identify every security and operational flaw and show the corrected configuration.
evals.expected_output: Activates the container-ecs-deploy skill and flags all 6 critical flaws: (1) `COPY .env.production` and `ARG`/`ENV AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` bake secrets permanently into image layers (`docker history`) — strictly forbidden by `SEM-006`, (2) passing `DATABASE_URL` in plaintext `environment` exposes credentials in `DescribeTaskDefinition` instead of injecting via `secrets` (`valueFrom` referencing a Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store ARN), (3) single-stage `FROM node:22` runs as `root` (`UID 0`) and pulls from Docker Hub instead of `public.ecr.aws` multi-stage with `USER 10001`, (4) shell-form `CMD npm run start` runs under `/bin/sh -c` and fails to forward `SIGTERM` to Node.js during graceful drain (must use `exec` form `CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]`), and (5) binding to `127.0.0.1:8080` causes ALB health checks to fail (`0.0.0.0:8080` required).
expectations: Activates the container-ecs-deploy skill and explicitly rejects baking `.env.production` and `ARG`/`ENV AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` into the image as well as passing plaintext `DATABASE_URL` in Task Definition `environment` variables

Shows wiring `DATABASE_URL` via the ECS Task Definition `secrets` block (`valueFrom` referencing Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store ARN) with `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` on `ecsTaskExecutionRole`

Refactors the `Dockerfile` to a multi-stage `public.ecr.aws` build running as non-root (`USER 10001`), using `exec`-form `CMD ["node", ...]` for PID 1 `SIGTERM` delivery, and binding the app to `0.0.0.0:8080` instead of `127.0.0.1:8080`
